name: 风云III修订版
english_description: The readme bundled with the original archive calls this “Storm III, revised by Xingxing” — a content-rich version compiled and revised by a community enthusiast going by “Xingxing.” It belongs to this batch's Fengyun III (Storm III) engine branch, sharing highly similar core code with fy3dz (the “Storm Collector's Edition”) — a different content package built on the same engine.
